usedFor: DocuSeal runs the signing and Google Docs keeps the record, with “Submission Completed” feeding “Add or Replace Text In Tab”.

bestTemplate.name: “Submission Completed” in DocuSeal, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: A completed submission can write its result into a doc tab, so finished forms leave a note.

watchOut: “New Template” in DocuSeal is polling, so a short delay is normal before a new template reaches the doc.
